From 27df68d579c67ef6c39a5047559b6a7c08c96219 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@somainline.org>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2021 19:37:24 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net/ipa: ipa_resource: Fix wrong for loop range

The source group count was mistakenly assigned to both dst and src loops.
Fix it to make IPA probe and work again.

Fixes: 4fd704b3608a ("net: ipa: record number of groups in data")
Acked-by: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@somainline.org>
Reviewed-by: Marijn Suijten <marijn.suijten@somainline.org>
Signed-off-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@somainline.org>
Reviewed-by: Alex Elder <elder@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20211111183724.593478-1-konrad.dybcio@somainline.org
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c b/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c
index e3da95d69409..06cec7199382 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c
@@ -52,7 +52,7 @@ static bool ipa_resource_limits_valid(struct ipa *ipa,
 				return false;
 	}
 
-	group_count = data->rsrc_group_src_count;
+	group_count = data->rsrc_group_dst_count;
 	if (!group_count || group_count > IPA_RESOURCE_GROUP_MAX)
 		return false;
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ipa/ipa_resource.c`**
- The variable `group_count` was originally assigned the value of `data->rsrc_group_src_count`.
- This assignment was changed to `data->rsrc_group_dst_count`, correcting the source of the group count used in the function.

### Relationships
The modification in `ipa_resource.c` addresses a bug where the wrong loop range was being used due to the incorrect assignment of the group count. By fixing the assignment to use the destination group count instead of the source group count, the patch ensures that the IPA (Internet Protocol Accelerator) can probe and function correctly, thereby resolving the issue introduced in a previous commit (4fd704b3608a).

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
group_count = data->rsrc_group_src_count;
for (j = group_count; j < IPA_RESOURCE_GROUP_MAX; j++)
```
Reason:
The variable `group_count` was incorrectly assigned the value of `data->rsrc_group_src_count`, which is meant for source groups, instead of the intended `data->rsrc_group_dst_count` for destination groups. This caused the loop to iterate over the wrong range, leading to improper validation of resource limits and preventing the IPA from functioning correctly.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
group_count = data->rsrc_group_dst_count;
for (j = group_count; j < IPA_RESOURCE_GROUP_MAX; j++)
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the assignment of `group_count` to use `data->rsrc_group_dst_count`, ensuring that the loop iterates over the correct range for destination groups. This fix allows the IPA to properly validate resource limits and function as intended.
